theme_description: Exclusive Light Theme per user request. Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) mixed with vibrant Indian cultural accents. The UI must feel simple, approachable, and highly accessible, avoiding any dark mode interfaces or purple hues.

layouts.global_structure: Left Sidebar App Navigation. The screen layout should comprise a fixed left sidebar (w-64) for navigation and a main content area that takes up the remaining width. A top header inside the main content area should hold the screen-reader toggle (top-right) and user profile.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6 for stat cards. Ensure items stretch equally.
layouts.marketing_landing: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Generous spacing (py-24, gap-12). Left-aligned text blocks with asymmetrical imagery.
layouts.spacing_scale: Use Tailwind generous spacing (p-6, p-8) for cards. Internal padding is mandatory for containers with borders.

navigation_sidebar.style: bg-white border-r border-slate-200 h-screen fixed left-0 top-0 w-64 p-4
navigation_sidebar.items: Home, How It Works, Features, Demo, Dashboard, Localize, History, Analytics

screen_reader_toggle.placement: Fixed or clearly positioned at the top-right corner of the application interface.
screen_reader_toggle.style: pill-shaped button, visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-pink-400 ring-offset-2), aria-label applied.

localization_workspace.stepper: Horizontal step indicator (Upload -> Analyze -> Translate -> Dub -> Export). Active step highlighted in Maroon, completed steps in Pink.
localization_workspace.upload_zone: Dashed border (border-2 border-dashed border-pink-300 bg-pink-50/50 hover:bg-pink-50 transition-colors). Drag & drop area with clear iconography.
localization_workspace.language_selector: Multi-select cards with Indian language names in English and native script. Subtle shadow, hover scale.
localization_workspace.processing_screen: Animated waveform using the Accent pink color. Loop animation to indicate active translation/dubbing.
localization_workspace.results_tabs: Original | Localized | Subtitles. Use Shadcn Tabs but styled card-less with underline indicators in Maroon.

players_and_viewers.video_comparison: Before/After synchronized players. Side-by-side on desktop, stacked on mobile.
players_and_viewers.transcript_viewer: Split pane (Source Language | Target Language). Clickable timestamps must have a subtle hover highlight (bg-blue-50).
players_and_viewers.subtitle_preview: Overlay on video with draggable/customizable controls (size, color, background pill).

cards.style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow p-6
cards.forbidden: Do not use generic drop-shadows. Stick to subtle tailwind shadow-sm.

motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0) using Framer Motion.
motion.hover_states: -translate-y-1 on cards. Buttons should have a slight scale-105 on active/hover.
motion.processing_state: Pulse animations on the audio waveform during the 'Analyze' and 'Dub' steps.
motion.universal_transition_forbidden: Do NOT use `transition: all`. Specify `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`, etc.

accessibility.screen_reader: Toggle must dynamically add/remove an 'aria-live' region or augment labels. Ensure 100% of inputs have associated `<label>`.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements MUST have focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-500 focus:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA/WCAG AA against backgrounds. Ensure pink and maroon contrast well against the light blue/white backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, tabs, inputs, and links.

hero_creator.description: Young Indian video creator looking at camera
hero_creator.usage: Hero section imagery, demonstrating the target audience.

dashboard_user.usage: Dashboard empty state or 'How it works' section.

processing_abstract.usage: Visual enhancer for the 'AI Architecture Pipeline' or the Processing Screen.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid heavy glass on this specific health/utility-like dashboard to maintain crisp legibility. Use Solid surfaces with 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid full screen gradients. Use subtle linear gradients for buttons only (e.g., Maroon to Light Maroon) or keep them solid.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use layered ambient shadows. shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] for elevated cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The tech stack requires JavaScript (.js, .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx, .ts). Do not generate .tsx files.
CRITICAL: Implement the Left Sidebar for App Navigation explicitly. Do not hide it behind a hamburger menu on desktop.
CRITICAL: Create a visible Screen-Reader Toggle at the top-right corner of the layout.
CRITICAL: Do not use any Dark Theme classes (like dark:bg-slate-900). The user explicitly requested NO dark themes.
CRITICAL: Do not use any purple colors. Only use Light Blue, White, Maroon, and Pink as specified.
CRITICAL: Never use transparent backgrounds under text elements (e.g., dropdowns, sticky headers).
CRITICAL: Use pure HTML+Tailwind for complex marketing layouts. Use Shadcn components for forms, tabs, and logical UI.
CRITICAL: Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or optical alignment.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor, Lucide, or Heroicons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
